title: introduce-tenant-kms-consent-flow-and-audit-envelope-rotator
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Customers asked for finer-grained control over which tenant keys may be used by hosted services and for a way to rotate audit envelope signing keys without downtime. This PR introduces a tenant-level KMS consent API, an admission-time check in the inference gateway, and a lightweight audit-envelope-rotator service that issues short-lived signing envelopes and automates key rollover. Changes include schema additions, API, runtime checks, migration tooling, docs, and end-to-end tests. Scope: - server: api/tenant_kms_consent endpoints for granting/revoking consent and a consent cache with TTL - gateway: check hook to validate request's kms key against tenant consent and produce audit tags on denial - audit-rotator: new microservice that fetches CMKs from configured providers, signs audit envelopes with rotating ephemeral keys, publishes rotation events to the event-bus - migrations: DB migration to add tenant_kms_consents table and audit_envelope_metadata - ops: console flags and migration steps for Dedicated/Private installs - tests: unit tests, integration tests using the emulated KMS and synthetic load. Rollout plan: 1) defaults to DENY for new tenants; existing tenants get permissive fallback until opt-in; 2) gradual rollout behind feature flag tenant_kms_consent_v1 with a canary in us-west; 3) audit-rotator started as sidecar in Dedicated, standalone in Hosted; 4) monitoring: new metrics tenant_kms_consent_denials, envelope_rotation_latency, envelope_sign_errors. Migration notes: backfill for existing records included; consenting customers should run `tools/migrate_kms_consent --dry-run` then commit. Testing: CI covers unit + integration; a small canary in staging validated KMS provider rotation for two providers. Related: Linear ENG-5123, ENG-5961. Breaking changes: None for customers who do not enable the feature flag. See release notes for Admin steps.

review_comments: Arjun Patel: Please ensure the gateway check is cheap on the fast-path; cache semantics should avoid contention under high QPS. Suggest using a probabilistic early-exit metric to detect cache churn.
Maya Chen: Addressed by adding a local LRU with background refresh and a TTL of 30s; added metrics for cache hit/miss and a probe to rate-limit refreshes.
Sofia Martinez: The migration must not break Private installers; add a safe-backfill that runs as a background job and avoid table scans during owner maintenance windows.
Maya Chen: Added a backfill job with batching and progress checkpointing; updated docs with required maintenance window guidance for on-prem customers.
Tomoko Yamada: Audit rotator uses KMS to fetch CMKs; ensure adapter supports fallback providers and error modes when provider API rate-limits.
Maya Chen: Implemented exponential backoff and a secondary provider adapter; rotator emits envelope_sign_errors and fallbacks are recorded in audit logs.
approvals: Tomoko Yamada: approved (comment: prefer gradual rollout)
release_notes: Tenant-level KMS consent API and rotation-capable audit envelope service. Admins can opt tenants into explicit KMS consent to restrict which CMKs hosted services may use. Adds DB migration and console UI. No customer-visible changes until feature flag 'tenant_kms_consent_v1' is enabled. Operators should follow the migration guide in docs/operations/tenant-kms-consent.md for Dedicated/Private.
